drums.tags: Hard rock with heavy metal influences. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs and power chords. A high-gain lead guitar performs a fast, technical solo featuring rapid alternate picking, legato runs, and wide vibrato. The bass guitar follows the guitar riffs with a thick, overdriven tone. The drum kit utilizes a double-kick pedal for rapid sixteenth-note patterns, a sharp snare, and frequent crash cymbal accents. 140 BPM. 4/4 time signature. Key of E minor.

[Intro]

[syncopated power chords, driving bass guitar]

[Guitar Solo]
[high-gain lead guitar enters, rapid alternate picking, wah-wah pedal effect]
[shredding legato runs, pinch harmonics]

[Outro]
[sustained power chord, final drum fill, cymbal crash]

bass.tags: Hardcore punk. Distorted electric guitar plays rapid down-stroked power chords in a constant eighth-note rhythm. The bass guitar follows the guitar root notes with a saturated, overdriven tone. Drums feature a high-tempo d-beat pattern with a sharp, cracking snare and consistent eighth-note hi-hat hits. Vocals are shouted with a raspy, aggressive delivery and minimal melodic variation. The production is raw with high-frequency emphasis and short room reverb on the drums. Key of E minor. 180 BPM. 4/4 time signature.
